Flying an unmanned aircraft here needs CAAM authorisation (MCAR 2016 reg. 140(1)(b); CAAM Safety Information 11/2022); this is not a flat ban. Zone height is not published. Source: AIP Malaysia AD 4, effective 2026-11-03.
